$comment: Who reads Tenon. One route for all of them: a git dependency pinned to a tag. sync reports which tag each is on and writes nothing — bumping a consumer means editing its own package.json and reinstalling, which is the point of pinning. An earlier version of this file had a second 'vendor' route that copied the built CSS into to-dos, on the belief that to-dos had no npm. It has React 18, Vite and TypeScript at its root, and server.py already carries the sibling-package static route twice.
